quest.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Safe Operation
quest.description: It seems someone is in trouble in the abandoned production zone...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Credit Coupons x280

talks.objective: Go to the abandoned production zone

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: No one comes here anymore after the Geode Mine Shaft was closed, and the devices here aren't meant for just anyone to handle.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: And that's exactly what happened this time. Someone tinkered with the drive valve and trapped their own companion.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's get it to open up the passage to <color=#00E1FFFF>Supply Warehouse 1</color>. By the way, if they offer you a drink, you'd best say no.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who's going to offer us a drink? And why won't we take it?

talks.objective: Operate the drive valve to open access to Supply Warehouse 1

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Mitul, are you alright? I hope you weren't trapped for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Mitul
dialogues.text: Where's Koblenz? He's not with you?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: He told me about trapping you here and asked for my help, but he left because a guard interrupted us.

dialogues.speaker: Mitul
dialogues.text: I knew he wasn't reliable! He probably ran away because he felt guilty.

dialogues.speaker: Mitul
dialogues.text: I mean, how do you make money in business if you don't take risks?

dialogues.speaker: Mitul
dialogues.text: He was clumsy, and too cautious, to boot... I mean, Pure Water is one thing, but even Fonta is available nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Mitul
dialogues.text: If Fonta is here, how are we supposed to survive?

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: I do! I have to admit, it's a formidable rival...

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: Anyway, I have to settle this with Koblenz. By the way, has he paid you?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Nope.

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: ...Sometimes I want to stuff him in a large bucket. That'll make him reflect on what he's done. Anyway, please take these Coupons.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Take them, you two, if you would.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? You want us to take all of it?

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thank you, then. We can go to the Rag and Bone Shop later to see if they have anything new.

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: By the way, I'd like to apologize for dragging you into this. I have some fresh health drinks — would you like a bottle?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fresh... health drinks?

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: Yup! Healthier than Pure Water, in fact!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hey, didn't Caterpillar tell you to not take one?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No, {NICKNAME} didn't mean it! We already had a lot of drinks before coming here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon bets these drinks are good! We'll make sure to try one next time.

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: Bad timing, huh? Well, come back when you get a chance. It'll be my treat!

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: Anyway, I must go talk to Koblenz now.

response.speaker: Caterpillar
response.text: I have something else to take care of, so I need to get going. Don't worry too much about the Coupons. <color=#00E1FFFF>I'll put the clues I come across on the blackboard</color>. Let's meet up later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: See you later!

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: Well, I have that, too. Wait. Do you have a problem with my healthy drinks? Let me tell you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's not what {NICKNAME} meant! It's just that we... had lots of drinks before coming here.

response.speaker: Mitul
response.text: A customer with taste, I see.
